system.description: The Solar transcends the need for sleep, remaining ever-vigilant in service of the Unconquered Sun. While this Charm is active, the Lawgiver suffers no adverse effects from sleep deprivation besides the lost opportunity for Willpower recovery. A character can use this Charm to go without sleep for (Stamina + Resistance) days. After that, she suffers one level of unsoakable bashing damage per day without sleep, which she must heal through rest before she can activate the Charm again. This Charm works like its Abyssal analogue, except that Solars cannot permanently abandon the need for sleep.
